samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Indicates whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Indicates whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Indicates whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Indicates whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input operand a.</assign>
        <assign id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input operand b.</assign>
        <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to store the result of the operation.</assign>
        <assign id="shift_amount" width_description="[4:0]">Shift amount for shift operations.</assign>
        
        <always_comb>
            <case id="operation_selection">
                <item id="ADD">
                    <assign res = $signed(a) + $signed(b); // Signed addition
                </item>
                <item id="ADDU">
                    <assign res = a + b; // Unsigned addition
                </item>
                <item id="SUB">
                    <assign res = $signed(a) - $signed(b); // Signed subtraction
                </item>
                <item id="SUBU">
                    <assign res = a - b; // Unsigned subtraction
                </item>
                <item id="AND">
                    <assign res = a & b; // Bitwise AND
                </item>
                <item id="OR">
                    <assign res = a | b; // Bitwise OR
                </item>
                <item id="XOR">
                    <assign res = a ^ b; // Bitwise XOR
                </item>
                <item id="NOR">
                    <assign res = ~(a | b); // Bitwise NOR
                </item>
                <item id="SLT">
                    <assign res = ($signed(a) < $signed(b)) ? 1 : 0; // Set less than
                </item>
                <item id="SLTU">
                    <assign res = (a < b) ? 1 : 0; // Set less than unsigned
                </item>
                <item id="SLL">
                    <assign shift_amount = a[4:0]; // Shift amount from input operand a
                    <assign res = b << shift_amount; // Logical left shift
                </item>
                <item id="SRL">
                    <assign shift_amount = a[4:0]; // Shift amount from input operand a
                    <assign res = b >> shift_amount; // Logical right shift
                </item>
                <item id="SRA">
                    <assign shift_amount = a[4:0]; // Shift amount from input operand a
                    <assign res = $signed(b) >>> shift_amount; // Arithmetic right shift
                </item>
                <item id="SLLV">
                    <assign res = b << a[4:0]; // Variable logical left shift
                </item>
                <item id="SRLV">
                    <assign res = b >> a[4:0]; // Variable logical right shift
                </item>
                <item id="SRAV">
                    <assign res = $signed(b) >>> a[4:0]; // Variable arithmetic right shift
                </item>
                <item id="LUI">
                    <assign res = {a[15:0], 16'h0}; // Load upper immediate
                </item>
                <default>
                    <assign res = 32'hzzzzzzzz; // Default case
                </default>
            </case>
        </always_comb>
        
        <assign flag = (aluc == 6'b101010 || aluc == 6'b101011) ? 1 : 1'bz; // Flag assignment based on control signal
        <assign zero = (res == 32'h00000000) ? 1 : 0; // Zero check
        <assign carry = (aluc == 6'b100001 || aluc == 6'b100011 || aluc == 6'b100000 || aluc == 6'b100010) ? res[32] : 1'bz; // Carry check
        <assign negative = (aluc == 6'b100000 || aluc == 6'b100010) ? res[31] : 1'bz; // Negative check
        <assign overflow = (aluc == 6'b100000 || aluc == 6'b100010) ? ((a[31] == b[31]) && (a[31] != res[31])) : 1'bz; // Overflow check
        
        <assign r = res[31:0]; // Assigning the result to output port r
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>ALU implementation based on the provided Verilog code.</implementation>
</module>
